items.note: Findings are the children’s unverified working material, never approval or verification. Each task’s report is its summary, findings, citations, open questions, confidence and what it did not do; its result is its text. A result cut at its head, or a report marked reportCut, continues with read_window at its more cursor. Open questions are yours to decide; one more batch is allowed after a batch that returned them. partial: the task reached its time limit and its result is what it had written. reused: an identical earlier task’s result, given again with no model request. Resume a complete task by giving its id in resume.
